name: Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple, Telangana
description: Ramappa Temple is a Shiva shrine in the village of Palampet, about 200 km north-east of Hyderabad in Telangana. Begun in 1213 and built over roughly four decades, its red sandstone walls carry finely carved dancers on pillars and brackets. The tower is made of such light, porous bricks that they are said to float. It sits beside a lake the Kakatiyas dug, amid fields and forest.
